Name: The Voice Of the Valley - Dynamically Disabled Custom NPC Rosalie
Author: stardewaly13
Description:
[center][b][size=5]🌹DESCRIPTION🌹[/size][/b][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][b]Meet Rosalie. The (somewhat) newest dynamically disabled resident of Stardew Valley.[/b][/color][/center]

[center][img width=150,height=150]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48457/48457-1782940752-1613960469.png[/img][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]Rosalie is a plus size BIPOC immigrant and has multiple invisible dynamic disabilities... and she's moving back to Pelican Town after 20 years![/color][/center]
[center][img width=100,height=125]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48457/48457-1782940751-2011911976.png[/img][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8]Rosalie used to live in Pelican Town 20 years ago before the war, but she is now moving back to live with her Uncle Gus at the Stardrop Saloon. [/color]
[center][img width=170,height=150]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48457/48457-1782941822-734083721.png[/img][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8]Some residents remember Rosalie as a sweet, shy, and sometimes mischievous child with a beautiful voice and big dreams and expectations, and now, are seeing her return as a disabled woman.[/color]

[center][color=#D4D4D8]  [img width=100,height=125]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48457/48457-1782941821-1563658043.png[/img][/color][/center]

[color=#D4D4D8]As you get to know Rosalie, and the residents we already know and love do too, you will discover not only the things she loves, but also the realities of living with her disability, the struggles of her everyday life during flare ups or avoiding them, the trauma she had to endure that lead her to moving back to Pelican Town, and her distrust in the people around her, even when they claim to care.[/color]

[center][img width=500,height=300]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48457/48457-1782873579-222362049.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[left][line]
[center][b][b]V 1.1.0 - Rosalie now has her Winter Outfits!
She will eventually have her wheelchair with it as well.[/b][/b][/center]


[center][img width=150,height=150]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48457/48457-1783913282-254138564.png[/img][img width=100,height=150]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48457/48457-1783913281-459236636.png[/img]
[i]Note: If you trigger a cut scene where she's supposed to be in her wheelchair, as of right now, she'll be in her generic clothes :(
I was hoping to have her wheelchair done for this update but it's still giving me trouble![/i][/center]
[/left]
[line]
[center][b][color=#93c47d][size=4]This mod was created by a person who also has invisible dynamic disabilities and draws from personal experiences without sensationalizing.[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][color=#93c47d][size=4]Content Warnings are listed below![/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][b][size=4]Please read the following content warnings to check that this mod is for you![/size][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][color=#00ff00][size=5]🌹 Content Warnings (Spoiler‑Free Version) 🌹[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][i](Safe for players who haven’t started her story yet)[/i][/center]
[spoiler][size=4][b]These appear softly and in passing, similar to vanilla Stardew Valley.[/b]
• Addiction (same level as SDV)
• Brief mentions of children being left alone
• Light discussions of war
• Body image comments (non‑graphic)
• Fatphobia and racism within the entertainment industry (non‑graphic; discussed gently)

[b]Explored with care and emotional support, never graphically.[/b]
• Depression
• Chronic pain and its emotional impact
• Ableism, including internalized ableism and misunderstandings from others
• Body image struggles, including external comments about weight
• Dark thoughts related to pain or hopelessness (not su*cidal)
• Cheating accusations (non‑graphic; discussed gently)
• Fear responses and bracing behaviors related to past experiences
• Discussions of controlling or emotionally unhealthy relationships

[b]Handled gently, non‑graphically, and always with emotional support and healing.[/b]
• Past relationship trauma
• Emotional manipulation
• One moment of victim‑blaming (challenged and apologized for)
• Non‑consensual physical affection (non‑graphic; addressed respectfully)
• Characters processing the aftermath of harmful behavior
• A single emotionally intense flare‑up scene involving chronic pain

[u][b]Even when heavier themes appear, they are:[/b][/u][b]
• gentle
• non‑graphic
• non‑sensational
• grounded in recovery and emotional growth
• presented with Stardew Valley’s cozy, character‑driven tone[/b][/size][/spoiler]


[center][color=#ffff00][size=5][b]🌹 Content Warnings ([u]Spoiler Version[/u]) 🌹[/b][/size][/color]
[i](If you'd like more specifics on what to expect from her story)[/i][/center]
[spoiler][size=4][b]Relationships & Safety[/b]
• Past marriage involving emotional manipulation and controlling behavior
• One brief confirmation of past physical harm (non‑graphic, not described)
• Characters processing trauma responses (bracing, fear of conflict, fear of being “trapped”)
• Discussions of narcissistic behavior (described gently, not labeled clinically)
• Short moment of victim‑blaming that is immediately challenged and apologized for
• Non‑consensual kissing (childhood and adult; non‑graphic; addressed respectfully)
• Implied intimacy / misunderstanding (non‑sexual; clarified immediately)
• Cheating accusations, including assumptions about her divorce and her ex moving on quickly

[b] Emotional Themes[/b]
• Depression, including one emotionally intense chronic‑pain flare‑up scene (non‑graphic; character supported; not suicidal)
• Chronic pain and its emotional impact
• Ableism, including internalized ableism and ableist assumptions from others
• Body image struggles, including external comments about weight and appearance
• Light mentions of dark thoughts (not suicidal)

[b] Social Themes[/b]
• Fatphobia and racism within the entertainment industry (non‑graphic; discussed gently)
• Addiction (similar to vanilla SDV)
• Brief mentions of children being left alone (similar to vanilla SDV; non‑graphic)
• Light discussions of war and its impact

[b]All sensitive themes are:[/b]
[b]• gentle[/b]
[b]• non‑graphic[/b]
[b]• non‑sensational[/b]
[b]• focused on recovery, support, and emotional growth[/b]
[b]• presented with Stardew Valley’s cozy storytelling tone[/b][/size][/spoiler]
[line]
[b][size=5]🌹Installation Instructions🌹[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Download the mod.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Download the required mods (and any optional ones if you'd like!)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Unzip the file[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Move it to the Contents folder of Stardew Valley, and into a folder labeled "Mods"[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Enjoy![/color][/*]
[/list][center][color=#d4d4d8][b]PS, you will need to unlock Rosalie for her to arrive. I will put below how so (don't worry, it's easy!)[/b][/color][/center]
[spoiler][color=#d4d4d8][b]To Unlock Rosalie you must...[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][b][color=#d4d4d8]Have at least 1 Heart with Gus (her Uncle)[/color][/b][/*]
[*][b][color=#d4d4d8]Receive a letter from Gus about the Saloon being under construction[/color][/b][/*]
[*][b][color=#d4d4d8]Go to Town after 6:10am to trigger a cut scene[/color]
[/b][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8][b]Afterward...[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][b][color=#d4d4d8][u]Gus will be gone for the rest of the day[/u] to help Rosalie pack[/color][/b][/*]
[*][b][color=#d4d4d8]The next day, you will receive a letter from Mayor Lewis that there's a (somewhat) new resident in Pelican Town[/color][/b][/*]
[*][b][color=#d4d4d8]Go say hello to Rosalie :)[/color]
[/b][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[line]
[b][size=5]🌹MAIN FEATURES🌹[/size][/b]

[b][url=https://www.tiktok.com/@stardewaly13/video/7616992097211665685?_r=1&_t=ZS-94iKt7igRHw][size=4]THE STARDROP SALOON BECOMES WHEELCHAIR ACCESSIBLE![/size][/url][/b]
[i]When Gus hears that his niece needs a place to stay, Robin will start construction on a ramp for the Saloon for the days Rosalie is in her wheelchair.[/i]

[b][color=#00ff00][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42900]A NEW TAB WITH THE "One Click News Radio" MOD BY @xetyaj! [/url][/size][/color][/b]
[i]As you play through Rosalie's story, Robin will eventually send over a letter saying she's selling radios! After purchasing a radio from Robin, you will have access to the [b]Exclusive "The Voice of The Valley"[/b] tab![/i]
[i]This gives you to the news about local birthdays, when the bookseller is in town, and what the Cart Merchant is selling that day (and highlighting items that are for bundles for the Community Centre!). This is ON TOP of the original mod's features of reading your luck, weather, fish, and audio episodes of The Queen of Sauce... . [b]All with ONE CLICK![/b][/i]
[center][i][b][img width=300,height=150]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48457/48457-1783062447-1093801615.png[/img][/b][/i][/center]

[b][color=#cc0000][size=4]ROSALIE IS A RIVAL NPC!🔥[/size][/color][/b]
[i]She is currently matched with her 'First Love' Interest, who I will refer to as Bachelor #1. [/i]
[i][b]HE WILL NOT BE AVAILABLE TO DATE AFTER ROSALIE MOVES IN![/b][/i]

[i]If you are dating him but not married, something will happen the day after he catches wind of her returning to Pelican Town, and will never be available again.[/i]

[i]You can now toggle this off by disabling [b]"It's Not You, It's Rosalie"![/b][/i]


[spoiler][b]Shane. [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48457/48457-1782940751-88442471.png[/img][/b][/spoiler]

[b][color=#00ffff][size=4]SHANE PORTRAIT CHANGE[/size][/color][/b]
[i]No need to download my "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42860]Actually Sad Shane[/url]" mod! With Rosalie, it will already be implemented, whether you interact with her or not.[/i]

[i]You can now toggle this off by disabling [b]"Actually Sad Shane Portraits"![/b][/i]
[i](Note: If you have the original ASS mod, you will need to disable BOTH of them. I recommend you remove it though and just stick with this one!)[/i]

[b][color=#9900ff][size=4]🎀 ROSALIE'S MINNIE ME🎀[/size][/color][/b]
[i]Jas has been staring at the new girl. More specifically, she's been obsessed with her iconic hair ribbon. Help Jas with her task, and she'll have a brand new look![/i]

[i]You can now toggle this off by disabling [b]"Rosalie's Minnie Me"![/b][/i]

[color=#d4d4d8][b][size=5]🌹FAQ🌹[/size][/b]
[i][size=5]Is Rosalie datable?[/size][/i]
[b]No. [/b]But she will be in the future!

For now...

[b]Rosalie is a RIVAL NPC! [/b][/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]She is currently matched with her 'First Love' Interest:[/color]

[spoiler][color=#d4d4d8][b]Shane. [/b][/color][/spoiler]
[color=#d4d4d8]
[b]Bachelor #2 has not been announced yet, [/b]but has been hinted in the dialogue.

I don't know if I will add any others, but I have ideas for stories for them!
[size=5]
[i]If I am dating Bachelor #1 before she is in the game, what happens?[/i][/size]
If you are not married to the person she is currently matched with, something will happen when she is said to come to town... Go ahead and try it! (You can now turn this off as of V 1.1.0)[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][size=5][i]How do I trigger an event or know if I missed something?[/i][/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]While Rosalie's events are all dependent on how many hearts you have with her, the ones with her and Bachelor #1 are very specific.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]If you're unsure of either, I have made a [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1oP-IzbqWNJJf_1GGUNrFK2co4hWrC3kW7NekmEcC6_o]map[/url]  that you can open each one depending if you want spoilers or not![/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][i](Note: as of July 16/26 the map is complete unless other scenes are added before Bachelor #2 is introduced or her randomized schedule affects it)[/i][/color]

[size=5][i]How much is this mod compatible with others?[/i][/size]
I unfortunately am unsure as there are so many here on Nexus and I was play-testing myself with only the mods that wouldn't directly affect her and her schedule as well as others whose schedules I changed.

Shane and Jas have portraits that do change. If that is an issue, you can disable them with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] mod!

Story wise, I did try to stay as Vanilla as possible in making this. With Bachelor #1's backstory, it may conflict with another mod's, but I tried not to write too much other than how Rosalie affected them, and other parts of their past.

I also, of course, have been working with @xetyaj on his One Click Radio mod since before development to ensure our mods work.

If you are one of the modders who created them or would like to integrate your mod with this, please let me know! You can DM me here, or contact me on discord!

[b]Mods I have been in contact with the Mod Devs on compatibility with so far: [/b]
-Diverse Stardew Valley
